Secret Scanning Custom Patterns

Load patterns.yml configs and deploy them at the enterprise, org, or repo level.
Known limitations:
  • Patterns are created as unpublished. Publishing & enabling push protection must be done in the GitHub UI (there is still no publish endpoint).
  • No API signal for dry-run status — you cannot tell when a pattern's dry run has completed or that it is ready to publish. The list endpoint exposes only state and push_protection_enabled.
  • This canvas only creates patterns. The API now also supports updating and bulk-deleting existing patterns, but this UI does not yet expose those actions.
  • The API now supports server-side filtering, sorting, and pagination on list endpoints; this canvas fetches the full deployed list (paginating internally) but still filters/sorts client-side for the UI.
  • Push protection can now be toggled via a separate API endpoint, but this canvas does not yet expose a toggle — use the deep link to manage it in the GitHub UI.
  • Enterprise endpoints are GHEC only and do not support GitHub App auth.
